notes.title: February 24, 2017 - Update
notes.notes:
Following changes have been made:

    Launcher is now available in English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish
    Launcher now has keyboard and controller support

notes.title: February 22, 2017 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
With feedback from the community we have added the following changes:

    Music will now play on the Splash screen as it did in the original game

    A TrickStyle Launcher has been added to the English version (Other language support to arrive shortly). In the launcher you may open nGlide and adjust the resolution scaling.

    Controller / Controls bug fix. Due to problems with the original game, if you were to open the game without a controller plugged in, the control scheme for that controller would be lost. Added implementation to restore the default control scheme should they be lost.

    Added folder directory for the TrickStyle soundtrack


A big thanks to everyone in the community with their feedback toward the game. Please continue to do so as we push forward with potential upcoming updates and our future releases. As always we appreciate any and all feedback!
